title: To repeal the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act and title I of the Health Care and Education Reconciliation Act of 2010 while preserving the reauthorization of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act.

summaries.text: Repeals the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, except provisions related to the Indian Health Care Improvement Reauthorization and Extension Act of 2009, and the health care provisions of the Health Care and Education Reconciliation Act of 2010, effective in 60 days.  Restores or revives provisions amended or repealed by such Act or such health care provisions.
